title: DecisionResponse
description: AI service -> core: the decider's proposal. Only a proposal; the core's rule guard has the final say.

tick.description: Echo of the request tick; the core discards stale responses.

option_id.description: Chosen option; must be one of the option_ids of the request.

expression.description: Optional body expression id from the expression vocabulary. The core maps it to an animation via a data table in content/ (not via the AI); an unknown id is dropped and the decision stays valid. Null if none.

rationale.description: Short English reasoning for logs and the debug view. Never shown to the player.

thought.description: Optional thought bubble in the player's language; null if none.
